generator.outputPolicy: Outputs are generated under the runtime project's obj/<Configuration>/net10.0/generated/System.Web directory and are not copied into src/System.Web.ReferenceSource.

integration.incrementalPolicy: MSBuild skips generation when all six outputs exist and are newer than the generator, manifests, and pinned Reference Source inputs.

staticBuildInputs.policy: One internal compile-time constants type is friend-visible to product assemblies. The non-packable helper is not copied to product output and does not appear in product dependency metadata.

explicitInputsOutsideImportedTree.purpose: Normalized declarations for the 27 constructible System.Web.RegularExpressions types, including patterns, options, visibility, and timeout constructors.
explicitInputsOutsideImportedTree.generatedImplementation: Generated constructors pass the original declared options plus RegexOptions.Compiled to the .NET 10 Regex base constructor.

explicitInputsOutsideImportedTree.purpose: Explicit desktop .NET Framework 4 Windows names.h macro values and FEATURE_PAL target selection required by Names.cspp.
explicitInputsOutsideImportedTree.sourceStatus: The public pinned Reference Source revision contains Names.cspp but does not contain its names.h include. Rehost records the reconstructed Windows profile as a project-owned input instead of selecting FEATURE_PAL or inheriting host-platform library names.
evidence: Names.cspp macro usages in the pinned imported tree
Microsoft .NET Framework 4.x module and registry identities represented by the compiled ModName constants

explicitInputsOutsideImportedTree.purpose: Explicit unsigned Rehost output identity, neutral resource identity, legacy Microsoft identity strings, checked-in AssemblyRef constants, and product version policy.
policySources: AssemblyRef and ThisAssembly usages in the pinned imported tree
Microsoft public-key token literals already present in the pinned System.Web sources
explicitInputsOutsideImportedTree.identityDistinction: The System.Web output carries the package family version and no strong-name token. AssemblyRef.MicrosoftPublicKey remains the legacy b03f5f7f11d50a3a reflection/configuration constant and does not claim that the Rehost output is Microsoft-signed.

pocComparisons.use: Historical golden: the generator reproduced this ResGen output byte-for-byte from System.Web.txt at blob 0beec0d0497dc6afd0b486e50aeee60308cd1905. Rehost has edited System.Web.txt since (first in 9bfaf5d0, 2026-09-08), so verify no longer pins these bytes; it parses the generated file with ResourceReader and requires every key and value to match System.Web.txt.
Comparison only: confirm reconstructed desktop Windows ModName values.
Comparison only: confirm pattern text and options after deriving the manifest from Microsoft's RegexPreCompiler.cs. The POC caller rewrites and static GeneratedRegex API were not copied.

Negative comparison: reject Portable.System.Web identities. The System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager identity is not rejected: since fcc0372d the runtime binds System.Configuration internals through that package and AssemblyRef.SystemConfigurationManager names it.
